d: We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Integration Engineer with 7+ years of experience in designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining complex enterprise integration solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in integration architecture, middleware technologies, APIs, and enterprise application connectivity, ensuring seamless data exchange and interoperability across diverse systems and platforms.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years of experience in enterprise application integration and software engineering.
Strong experience with enterprise integration patterns and architecture.
Hands-on experience with middleware and integration platforms such as:
IBM App Connect / IBM Integration Bus (IIB)
Oracle SOA Suite / Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, and OpenAPI specifications.
Experience with API management platforms and API gateways.
Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
Experience with messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or IBM MQ.
Knowledge of database technologies, SQL, and data integration concepts.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud).
Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols, including OAuth 2.0, JWT, and SAML.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps practices.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
Exposure to event-driven architecture and real-time data streaming.
Experience working in large-scale enterprise environments, preferably banking, telecommunications, or financial services.
Relevant certifications in MuleSoft, IBM, Oracle, Microsoft Azure, or AWS are a plus.
r: li
Design, develop, and implement scalable enterprise integration solutions across multiple applications and platforms.
li
Lead the integration of enterprise systems, including ERP, CRM, core banking, and other business applications.
li
Develop and manage APIs, web services, and microservices-based integrations.
li
Design and implement integration workflows using middleware and Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) technologies.
li
Establish integration patterns, standards, best practices, and governance frameworks.
li
Collaborate with enterprise architects, solution architects, developers, and business stakeholders to understand integration requirements.
li
Implement and maintain RESTful APIs, SOAP services, messaging systems, and event-driven architectures.
li
Ensure secure, reliable, and high-performance data exchange between internal and external systems.
li
Troubleshoot complex integration issues and perform root cause analysis.
li
Monitor integration performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies.
li
Ensure integration solutions comply with security, data privacy, and enterprise architecture standards.
li
Provide technical leadership, conduct code reviews, and mentor junior engineers.
li
Prepare and maintain technical documentation, integration specifications, and architecture diagrams.

d: Reporting directly to the Head of Human Resources and based at our Abu Dhabi headquarters, the HR Business Partner will act as the main HR point of contact for Group entities within Group HR Shared Services, working closely with CEOs, managers and employees.

The role will translate business priorities into practical HR actions, covering workforce planning and budgets, onboarding, performance management, training, talent development and employee relations. Working with the HR Direction and the team, you will provide coordinated support and promote consistent practices across the Group entities.
We are looking for someone who combines business understanding with a hands-on approach, builds strong relationships and can advise and constructively challenge managers.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field; an HR professional qualification is an advantage.
At least five years of relevant HR experience, including a business partnering or broad generalist role.
Experience in workforce planning, performance management, employee relations and development; experience supporting several entities is an advantage.
Working knowledge of applicable UAE employment frameworks.
Strong communication, judgement and organisational skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and handle sensitive matters discreetly.
Proficiency in HR systems and Microsoft Excel.
Fluent English; Arabic or French is an advantage.
r: li
Partner with entity CEOs and managers on people priorities, team structures and organisational development.
li
Contribute to workforce planning and budget discussions, including headcount, new positions, personnel costs and training needs.
li
Support job opening requests and coordinate recruitment priorities with hiring managers and the recruitment team.
li
Coordinate new joiner welcome, onboarding and probation follow-up.
li
Facilitate objective setting, performance evaluations and follow-up on development or improvement plans.
li
Identify training needs, consolidate plans and budgets, and coordinate approved development activities.
li
Support talent reviews, succession planning, career development and internal mobility, including UAE national development initiatives.
li
Advise managers and employees on HR policies and employee matters, supporting fair and consistent handling in line with applicable requirements.
li
Identify employee concerns and retention risks, and follow up on practical improvements.
li
Support organisational changes and coach managers on feedback, conflict resolution and team development.
li
Coordinate with recruitment, administration, payroll and HRIS teams to ensure timely HR support.
li
Analyse HR indicators, report on priorities and contribute to improvements in Group HR policies and processes.
